budget.counting: Every new physical-task start counts, including early failure and a run superseded by a confirmed fix. At most 8 development attempts, at most 60 formal records, at most 68 total new starts; valid overlap/reuse is not double-counted and batch names do not reset the budget. Five optimizer seeds are not five independent materials. No old 85-episode rerun.

development_reused_as_formal.reason: Complete mission executed at frozen formal source; one physical attempt serves development and formal result.

development_superseded.reason: Complete rigid nominal-control equivalence evidence retained; nominal forecast tail stand switching and soft target IK interface corrected in later version.
Confirmed pre-contact stance tracking activation and planned-equals-actual tangential force tail errors corrected; original full successful trajectory retained.

stance_tracking_alignment: References generated at t are compared to actual feet and force at t + 0.002 s; inactive references are excluded and no missing old diagnostics are replaced with zero.
metric_interpretation: All observed data end at actual termination. Failed duration/work is not completion time/efficiency. Joint work is not battery consumption. Missing reused diagnostics remain absent.
prediction_timing_interpretation: The first saved prediction call includes possible compilation plus actual prediction work; it is not a measurement of compilation alone. Later saved calls provide separate P50/P95/max and deadline misses. The reported deadline is the configured 0.2 s planning target; B1 nominal diagnostic recording actually occurs once per 1 s. These wall times describe synchronous server simulation, not NX real time.
forecast_alignment: Interpolate recorded actual values at forecast absolute time; actual GRF uses full-rate physics samples at the explicit forecast GRF timestamp. Planned GRF uses zero-order hold at that timestamp, never interpolation across a command change. Samples beyond observed time are excluded. Short errors reuse the same long prediction. Common prefix ends at 0.2 s or the next planning record; longer tails are separate.
forecast_timestamp_correction: For a confirmed early-substep rejection (material_domain_exit, soft_region_nonfoot_contact or invalid_contact), a saved final pose timestamp that extends past the last GRF timestamp plus one 0.2 ms physics step is corrected only in derived comparison samples when the original first-rejection timestamp equals that GRF timestamp. The correction table retains original pose time, predicted duration, rejected cost and final-interval overcount. Raw plans and original rejected costs remain unchanged; missing endpoint fields prevent exact cost reconstruction. These infeasible candidate costs were not ranked. Physical task outcomes and trajectories are unchanged, and no task rerun is required for this metadata correction.
event_matching: Each predicted patch event matches at most one actual cross-leg event ID per forecast within 150 ms and the same world patch/leg. Precision uses prediction instances whose event time is observed before actual termination; later predictions remain unobserved. Recall counts unique actual event IDs over the whole episode, never rolling-window repetitions. Long-tail events remain conditional on the forecast future controls.
event_state_interpretation: e_before_step and q_before_step are the actual material state preceding the current step. preload_free_e and preload_free_q are the zero-external-stress candidate used by unilateral contact detection before imposing the new load; they are not a second actual integration or automatically an observed residual-memory state, especially during a contact-owner transfer. postload_e and postload_q are the resulting actual loaded state. Missing legacy B0 fields remain unrecorded.
material_rate_interpretation: Continuous loaded strain rates, activation/release strain jumps, actual foot vz/H and qdot are separate. The reported vz/H extrema apply to loaded feet; all foot velocities remain in the full-rate physics trace. Total-strain finite-difference peak is not an impact speed.

parallel_execution.physical_execution: Unmodified run_terrain_memory_s1.py and s1*.py; same configuration, controller, RNG seeds and physical step.
parallel_execution.bookkeeping: One coordinator writes the existing index. Workers use separate output cohorts and return their actual result paths. No extra physical tasks or retries.
parallel_execution.timing_scope: Previously completed attempts were serial. The retained active attempt switches from serial to shared resources at authorized_utc; new workers share CPU/GPU/memory. These wall times are not isolated per-method speed comparisons or NX real time.

decision_commitment_interpretation: decisions.csv has one row per recorded B2/B3 candidate in each decision, including exact-minimum IDs, continuation and failures. A continuation offset remains null because it retains the current pending plan rather than declaring a new zero offset. footstep-commitments.csv contains only live WB group records from the actual commitment file: serial/time/legs/shared scalar and the saved MPC action-effective time. These committed groups are distinct from candidate-predicted groups and actual material touchdown/revisit events; no commitment is reconstructed from predictions.
legacy_predictor_fields: For B0-B3, contact_env.predictor aliases the actual reference ground. The legacy episode predictor_domain_exit therefore duplicates actual material-domain exit; candidate rejections are recorded in plans and first-candidate-rejections.csv. The independent frozen-C4 observer is paused. Its legacy timing.predictor and trace.predictor_s are zero in this round and do not measure nominal or candidate forecasting.

attempt_totals.scope: All unique finished new physical attempts from the run ledger, including every development failure and adopted development attempt once. Identity uses the actual trajectory path and saved SHA256. Active attempts have no invented duration/wall total; historical reused B0 is excluded.

formal_new_totals_scope: total_recorded_episode_wall_s and total_new_simulated_duration_s below cover new physical evidence represented by formal result rows, including adopted development once, and exclude old B0 and development-only attempts. The broader attempt_totals include development-only attempts as well; these totals overlap and must not be added.

timing_component_definitions.control_s: Live MPC and WB execution, including the active stance-tracking path.
timing_component_definitions.resource_comparability: timing.csv and episodes.csv label serial, historical_serial, serial_then_parallel and parallel. See index.parallel_execution for the user-authorized switch and concurrency. Shared-resource wall times are not isolated method speed comparisons.
timing_component_definitions.physics_s: Actual robot physics and actual material/contact updates; material_s is an overlapping component, not an additional nonoverlapping duration.
timing_component_definitions.upper_prediction: timing.upper measures candidate or nominal cloned rollout, including cloned MPC, WB, material integration and robot physics. prediction_after_first_call measures these same forecast calls after the first call.
timing_component_definitions.predictor: Legacy timing.predictor / trace.predictor_s measures the independent frozen-C4 constitutive observer update, not candidate prediction. It is zero because C4 is paused; forecast cost is in upper and the separately split prediction-call timings.
timing_component_definitions.total_s: Observed outer control-loop wall time. Component intervals overlap; do not sum their P50/P95 or overlapping durations.
timing_component_definitions.scope: Execution-server synchronous functional simulation. Physical time pauses for computation; these measurements do not establish NX real time.

clocks_and_quadrature.cost: The common B2/B3 stage-cost formula uses physical-time quadrature in 20 ms intervals and the same terminal formula. It is not a count of prediction samples; longer horizons change the evaluated future and computation.
clocks_and_quadrature.contact_work: Actual contact force (N) dotted with foot velocity (m/s), integrated at 5000 Hz; normal and tangential components are separate.
clocks_and_quadrature.joint_work: Recorded actuator torque (N m) times joint velocity (rad/s), integrated at 500 Hz. Positive mechanical work is not battery energy.

scientific_conclusions.contact_execution: B1在KV8000由4/5变为5/5，刚地仍为5/5；TM02仍实际应变超域，KV3500仍出现小腿触地。B1反演共同足底位移的面积加权合力，并在实际WB力矩路径执行支撑运动参考；GRF前馈只计一次。这是已知材料状态下的接触执行对照，不是完整STANCE c3WBC复现。
scientific_conclusions.aligned_planning: B2/B3继承正在执行的摆腿、接触与MPC状态，仅改变下一组未承诺落足的一次共享偏移，共用执行、信息、代价与约束。刚地B2 seed3在6.0s结束：当次三个候选都预测在6.166s首次违反落足IK条件，此前可比较前缀与实际一致；6.166s是预测拒绝时刻，不是实际跌倒时刻。该失败保留。本轮比较短、长预测，没有把长时域本身称为事件创新，也未建立跨腿持久材料记忆的因果收益。
scientific_conclusions.paired_results: B3在刚地和KV8000均为5/5，B2分别为4/5和3/5；B1在这两种地面也是5/5。B3的平均完整任务时间分别为40.6872s和39.0748s，同五个配对seed相对B1分别减少0.2992s和0.4272s。长预测修复了本轮短预测中的完成率损失，但相对B1没有完成率增益；计算量明显更高。
scientific_conclusions.interpretation: 新增PANN/PPO训练0，C4暂停，硬件0。全部成功与失败轨迹保留，失败后的值不补零。五个seed是优化器配对种子，不是五种独立材料；只对双方完成的配对比较完成时间。关节机械功不是电池耗电，提前失败的短轨迹不代表更快或更节能。同步功能仿真的物理时间会等待计算，分项耗时及首调用单列，NX实时性未测。用户随后授权并行完成剩余独立回合；索引和逐回合记录区分串行、切换中及共享资源运行，这些混合资源条件下的wall time不能直接作为算法独占计算速度对比。
